current.title: Round 56 DELIVERED — the launch-choice round (fourth packaged-app session)
current.detail: The owner's report after 0.55.0: 'still not working it failed and i think in the acute.bat it should ask how to launch the app or the site.' Two answers shipped. (1) THE LAUNCH QUESTION: every interactive run now asks how to launch — [1] the desktop app, [2] the site in the browser — with Enter keeping the last choice (remembered in .acute-launch-pref.json), ACUTE.bat app / ACUTE.bat site skipping the question, --app/--site/--web flags preserved, non-Windows always site, and non-interactive runs using the saved choice. (2) ENGINE-FAILURE RECOURSE: when the desktop engine does not report ready the launcher prints the engine's log tail (the timeout path too — it was blind, the exact silence that hid EISDIR) and asks retry / use-the-site / keep — a dead engine is never a dead end. The self-update now re-execs the fresh launcher in place (ACUTE_LAUNCHER_REEXEC loop guard) so launcher logic drives the session it arrives in; ACUTE.bat status reports the launch preference + the engine's last successful boot line; the launch line names the version. All launcher paths logic-tested in-sandbox: mode resolution (commands/flags/tty/pref), ask parsing + persistence, recourse branches (site/retry/keep) end-to-end through desktop_flow, exec mechanics verified with a real process replacement (args + exit code preserved, guard honored).
